segmentos.texto: You put this on at 7 in the morning for a Sunday out, and by 9 at night, people are still asking what you're wearing.
This is New Orbis. It opens with pineapple, mango, passion fruit, and fresh citrus right away.
But wait for it. As it settles on skin, the warm woods come through and everything changes.
This is the moment you stop smelling like just another fragrance, and start smelling like confidence.
And this isn't one of those fragrances that disappears after an hour.
It's made to stay with you through the day and into the night.
